name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn Halvorsen's fascination with speed began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's workshop in Bergen. He channeled this passion into a degree in mechanical engineering from the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, focusing on advanced materials and combustion systems. After graduation, Bjørn joined a small rally team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving under pressure. He honed his skills across various motorsport disciplines, from rallycross to touring cars, before transitioning to open-wheel racing.

His methodical approach and deep understanding of vehicle dynamics make him a sought-after chief engineer. Bjørn believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's input is valued. He's known for his meticulous data analysis and his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies. Bjørn is driven by a relentless pursuit of performance, constantly seeking incremental improvements that can give his team a competitive edge. He approaches every race with a quiet intensity, always one step ahead in anticipating potential challenges.

At Meyer Shank Racing, Bjørn aims to instill a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. His leadership extends beyond technical expertise; he is a mentor and motivator, dedicated to developing the next generation of racing engineers. He is particularly interested in advanced materials and is constantly looking for ways to incorporate new technologies into the team's cars. Bjørn's loyalty to his team is unwavering, and he is known for his dedication to achieving collective success.
